download_url: download a file from a URL and return its bytes and content type
get_cos_credentials: get temporary COS upload credentials by calling the genUploadInfo API endpoint
upload_to_cos: upload file bytes to Tencent Cloud COS using HMAC-SHA1 signed PUT request
build_image_msg_body: build a Tencent TIM image message body with url, size, width, and height
build_file_msg_body: build a Tencent TIM file message body with url, filename, uuid, and size
